operator_io_quirks: All identifiers lowercase, no spaces; still quote them.
incidents.case_number is TEXT PK with mixed formats: '031347-2015' (zero-padded, dash), '1004453N'/'100577T' (suffix letter). Not a uniform pattern.
incidents.date declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY/M/D' (slash, no zero-pad, e.g. '2015/2/9'). TS Date fuzzer template detection must handle slash format; first element not int so Date path.
officers/subjects have NO primary key (pk=[]); upstream sample_fresh_primary_keys/drop_unique_duplicates must no-op on empty PK.
officers.case_number and subjects.case_number are FKs to incidents.case_number (unique parent, fine) but child distinct (219/216) < child rows (370/223): many-to-one, duplicates expected.
subjects.case_number distinct 216 < incidents 219: some incidents have no subject; officers 219 = all incidents covered.
subject_count INTEGER distinct only 4 (0..3), tiny domain; Number fuzzer will produce wide ints.
race/gender are single-char codes (L/W/B/A, M/F); String fuzzer will emit random 0-20 char strings, not codes.
full_name is 'Last, First' composite of last_name/first_name; TS treats independently so correlation lost.
first_name/race nullable (null_rate 0.008-0.081); TS does not enforce NOT NULL, insert failures skipped.
subject_weapon has typo 'Toy Handun' and multi-word 'Deceased Injured' in subject_statuses: values are free text, not enum.
subjects column in incidents is a denormalized 'Last, First B/M' string, distinct 205 of 219.
operator_ts_expectations: incidents.date: Date fuzzer, template from first parsable element; slash format '%Y/%m/%d' likely; range from min/max parsed dates (~2004..2016).
incidents.case_number: String fuzzer, random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0-20, plus contaminate; will not match 'NNNNNN-YYYY' pattern -> FN on format/prefix queries.
subject_count: Number fuzzer, int scale 4, range [-10^4,10^4] with +-1/+-2 perturbation; original 0..3 -> implausible large counts -> FN on count predicates, FP on range.
race/gender: String fuzzer random strings, not {L,W,B,A}/{M,F} -> FN on equality/enum queries.
officers/subjects.case_number: FK fill draws from incidents final case_number values with replacement -> duplicates and coverage OK, but only 219 distinct parents for 370/223 rows.
No PK on officers/subjects: sample_fresh_primary_keys no-op; drop_unique_duplicates no-op (no unique cols) -> duplicate rows possible, may inflate COUNT results -> FP.
full_name/last_name/first_name independent random strings -> 'Last, First' correlation broken -> FN on join/string-concat or LIKE '%,%' queries.
subject_weapon/subject_statuses: random strings, not the 21/7 real values -> FN on enum/IN queries.
location: random strings, not street addresses -> FN on LIKE '%Road%' style.
Date fuzzer p inverted: p=0.2 default means element returned w.p. 0.2, fresh dates otherwise; with 5 sampled originals range may be narrow.

Empty literal pool for most columns (no train SQL given here) -> samplers rely on 5 original values + fresh draws; max_l0 cap may reuse few values -> low diversity, ties/duplicates -> FP on DISTINCT/COUNT DISTINCT.
NOT NULL not enforced in Python: NULLs from String/Date samplers on notnull columns fail insert and are skipped -> row counts shrink, may drop below expected -> FN on COUNT thresholds.
